acquisition method: analyzed using DDA on a TripleTOF 5600+ mass spectrometer
alkylation reagent: cysteine side chains were blocked by methyl methanethiosulfonate (MMTS) treatment
collision energy: The top 12 peaks were triggered for HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30
enrichment method: Samp3ylated proteins were purified by α-Flag chromatography
fractionation method: fractionated into 14 fractions by strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX)
instrument: connected to an LTQ Orbitrap-Velos mass spectrometer
labeling: Multiplex quantitative stable isotope labeling in cell culture (SILAC) was used
